P3 preregistration: on stabcls_06550f same dimension16 default-init depth4 width256 GELU LN[true,false,true,false], CE, T512 batch64 samples32768, compare full q_a57013 adaptive recipes RMSprop lr3e-5 wd.001, AdamW lr.0003 wd1e-5 betas .9/.999, Adagrad lr.003 wd1e-5, Adagrad lr.0001 wd.001. Existing Adagrad slow cell reused for comparison only, not rerun. Predict RMSprop beats AdamW (original order transfers), but high Adagrad beats low Adagrad (rate-only negative-control prediction). This comparison deliberately changes optimizer/full config: it can test recipe-order transport, not identify rate causality.

P4 preregistration: test visible-history dataset reversal analogues without repeating existing experiments. On stabcls_03d886 smooth_additive and stabcls_0db74c sparse_interaction, both dimension8 and 1024 train/2048 test rows, default-init residual ReLU MLP depth2 width192 LN[false,true], CE, AdamW wd1e-5 betas .9/.999, T1024 batch32 samples32768 (32 exposure epochs). Rates3e-5 and .001. Predict high rate wins sparse and low rate wins smooth, mirroring q_a9073c/q_07b812. Compare only within each experiment set; dataset transfers hold recipe/budget/dimension fixed but rule, active features, weights and split seed change jointly. Failure means the named historical reversal does not transport to these lab instances; no family-wide rate cutoff.
